name: Young and Teen Writers Workshop
what_you_do: Two-week summer workshops in the afternoon. You pick two creative writing classes: fiction, genre fiction, poetry, plays, or intro to creative writing. Your work can appear in a printed book.
who_can_apply: Writers ages 10 to 19, in two workshops. Young Writers: entering grades 5 to 8 in fall 2027. Teen Writers: rising grades 9 to 12 and recent graduates, with a writing sample.
deadline_text: 2027 dates: Young Writers July 12-23, 2027. Teen Writers July 20-31, 2027. Applications are closed; the pages say to check back in spring 2027. No 2027 deadline is posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application for your workshop. If you are accepted, pay tuition by July 1. Your place is not saved until you pay.
notes: Young Writers is ages 10 to 14. Teen Writers is ages 14 to 19. $376 is from the 2026 listing. Teen Writers says Monday to Friday, but July 20, 2027 is a Tuesday, so check that date.
